SELECT 
  fish_date_doy,
  fish_date_season,
  cls,
  COUNT(*) as num_boats,
  ROUND(SUM(yt)::FLOAT / SUM(anglers)::FLOAT, 3) as avg_share
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season = 6 
  AND fish_date_doy >= 20
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, fish_date_season, cls
ORDER BY fish_date_doy, cls

SELECT 
  ts_doy,
  ts_season,
  ROUND(AVG(wtmp_c)::FLOAT, 2) as avg_wtmp_c,
  ROUND(AVG(wtmp_c) * 9.0/5.0 + 32, 1) as avg_wtmp_f
FROM pier
WHERE ts_season = 6
  AND ts_doy >= 20
GROUP BY ts_doy, ts_season
ORDER BY ts_doy

SELECT 
  fish_date_doy,
  fish_date_season,
  cls,
  COUNT(*) as num_boats,
  ROUND(SUM(yt)::FLOAT / SUM(anglers)::FLOAT, 3) as avg_share
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season = 2 
  AND fish_date_doy >= 90
  AND fish_date_doy <= 120
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, fish_date_season, cls
ORDER BY fish_date_doy, cls
LIMIT 60

SELECT 
  report_date_doy,
  report_date_season,
  yt_all,
  yt_local,
  migrated,
  LEFT(text, 200) as report_summary
FROM fishdope
WHERE report_date_season = 6
  AND report_date_doy >= 25
ORDER BY report_date_doy DESC
LIMIT 5
